_rules.Q402: output switch hung from the RIGHT side of the fixed inductor's pad 2: rot 90 puts the gate edge (SW pad exit between the gate pins) facing L401.2, so SW2 joins the inductor on F.Cu over ~1 mm; courtyard abuts L401's courtyard; D1 (BAT) column at the bottom, S2 (GND) at the top, cap edge toward the board edge
_rules.C438: HF output cap centred on Q402's cap edge (offset courtyard half 1.945 + cap half 0.505), pad 1 (BAT) over D1 (bottom), pad 2 (GND) over S2 (top)
_rules.C431: first BAT bulk: horizontal 1210 left of the BAT drop under Q402's D1 edge, BAT pad (1) on the right touching the drop, GND pad left with vias
_rules.C434: second BAT bulk: horizontal 1210 under C431, BAT pad on the right touching the drop, GND left with vias
_rules.R447: LG2 gate resistor straight above Q402's LG2 pin (top-left), LG2 pad toward the pin
_rules.R427: BAT sense resistor straight below Q402's D1 edge: BAT drops ~6 mm from D1 to its pad 1; pad 2 (PACK_P) next to J113
_rules.R428: Kelvin filter at R427 pad 1 (SRP), left of it
_rules.R429: Kelvin filter at R427 pad 2 (SRN), left of it
